entities.summary: John M. Stephens is an Australian former professional baseball player. He pitched part of the 2002 season for the Baltimore Orioles, and last pitched in 2006 for the Reading Phillies. He also pitched for several years with the Australian national team, winning an Olympic silver medal in 2004. Stephens was a right-handed pitcher with a listed height of 6'1" and a listed weight of 204 pounds.
